items.originalTitle: Max Verstappen to start Brazilian GP from back of grid as Red Bull confirms penalty
detailZh: 四届F1冠军维斯塔潘将在巴西大奖赛从后位起跑，红牛车队负责人劳伦特·梅基斯确认。
维斯塔潘将在巴西大奖赛从后位起跑，红牛确认他将接受引擎处罚。
对于红牛车队的粉丝来说，关注红牛赛车，了解F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和比赛分析。
四届F1冠军维斯塔潘将在巴西大奖赛从后位起跑，红牛车队负责人劳伦特·梅基斯确认了这一消息。
红牛车队策略总监汉娜·施密茨在圣保罗赛道第二次练习赛结束后解释说，米尔顿凯恩斯的团队正在为马克斯的赛车考虑几个改动。有一些事情他不太满意，但我们知道是什么，所以我们可以着手解决它们。
在第三次练习赛之前接受天空体育F1采访时，梅克斯确认了荷兰人的处罚。
“我们将不得不为马克斯承受一个引擎处罚。他将从最后一位发车——这是他在过去两年中非常熟悉的位置，”梅克斯说。
“他在这里从后发车已经完成了一些奇迹，我们相信他今年还会完成更多。”
尽管维斯塔潘将承受处罚，梅基斯补充说，在第一和第二次练习赛中，车的速度“相当不错”。
“星期五总是很辛苦的工作。一点也不糟糕，”他解释道。
“车的速度相当不错。是的，你听到了很多无线电通讯，但对我们来说，我不确定对其他人来说是否如此，我们在星期五有很多事情要追求，以优化圈速，挖掘出所有潜力。”
“在许多方面，我们今年取得的进步是因为我们追求一切的精神。昨天也不例外，希望我们今天能把车调整得更好。”
上周末赢得墨西哥大奖赛后，维斯塔潘在车手积分榜上攀升至第二位。梅赛德斯车队的基米·安东内利在墨西哥城夺得冠军，但第二名的争夺战仍在继续。维斯塔潘和第五位的勒克莱尔之间只有16分之差。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿和乔治·拉塞尔分别位列第三和第四，两人都将受到处罚。拉塞尔将受到五位的发车位置处罚，而汉密尔顿处罚的具体情况尚未确定。
detailEn: Max Verstappen to start Brazilian GP from back of grid as Red Bull confirms penalty
Max Verstappen will start the Brazilian Grand Prix from the back of the grid after Red Bull confirmed he will take an engine penalty
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Four-time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen will start the Brazilian Grand Prix from the back of the grid, Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies has confirmed.

Red Bull's head of strategy Hannah Schmitz explained after the second practice session at Interlagos that the Milton Keynes outfit was "looking into several changes for Max's car. There were things he was unhappy with, but we know what they are so can work on them."
Speaking with Sky Sports F1 ahead of the third practice session, Mekies confirmed the penalty for the Dutchman.
"We will have to take an engine penalty with Max. He will start from the back - a position he knows very well here after the last two years," Mekies said.
"He's done a few miracles in the past starting from the back here and we're sure he will do a few more this year."
While Verstappen will take the penalty, Mekies added that the pace of the car was "decent" during the first two practice sessions.
"It's always hard work on Friday. It wasn't bad at all," he explained.

"The pace of the car was decent. Yes, you heard a lot of radio communication, but certainly for us, I'm not sure for the other guys, there are a number of things we are chasing on a Friday to optimise lap time to extract everything.
"In many respects, the progress we've had this year is because of this spirit we have of chasing everything. That was no different yesterday and hopefully we have the car in a better place today."

After winning the Mexican Grand Prix last weekend, Verstappen moved up to second in the drivers' championship. Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli claimed the title in Mexico City, but the fight for second continues. Only 16 points separate Verstappen in second place and Charles Leclerc in fifth.

Lewis Hamilton and George Russell sit third and fourth, respectively, and both will also be taking penalties. Russell will receive a five-place grid penalty, while the extent of Hamilton's penalty is yet to be confirmed.
keyPointsZh: 红牛车队确认了引擎处罚
keyPointsEn: Red Bull confirmed the engine penalty

items.titleZh: 巴西大奖赛获得五年延期
items.summaryZh: F1巴西大奖赛获得五年延期，至少持续到2030年代中期。
items.originalTitle: F1's Brazilian Grand Prix gets five-year extension
detailZh: 一级方程式巴西大奖赛获得了五年延期，使其至少保持在2030年代中期之前的赛历上。
巴西之前的合同原定于2030年到期，但在2026年周末的周六，F1宣布了一项新的五年延期。
Interlagos在1973年首次出现在赛历上，自1990年以来一直独家举办巴西F1赛事。
F1声称巴西有580万粉丝，从2024年到2025年同比增长6.5% - 其中44%为女性，41%年龄在35岁以下。
去年周末的观众人数记录为303,627人。
“巴西是F1历史的重要组成部分，也是我们的未来，我很高兴这个五年的延期将使我们继续在圣保罗赛车，直到2035年，”F1总裁兼首席执行官斯蒂法诺·多梅尼卡利表示。
“我们巴西粉丝的热情是非凡的，每次我们回到英特拉戈斯，我们都能在看台上和圣保罗市感受到他们的能量。”
大奖赛首席执行官艾伦·阿德勒将延期称为“巨大的骄傲来源”，并表示它“代表着对基于奉献、投资和长期愿景所做工作的认可。”
detailEn: Formula 1's Brazilian Grand Prix has earned a five-year extension, keeping it on the calendar until at least the mid-2030s.
Brazil's previous contract was set to expire in 2030, but on the Saturday of the 2026 weekend, a new five-year extension was announced by F1.
Interlagos made its F1 debut on the calendar in 1973 and has hosted the Brazil F1 race exclusively since 1990.
F1 claims there's a fanbase in Brazil of "5.8 million, a 6.5% year-on-year increase from 2024 to 2025 - 44% of whom are female and 41% of whom are under 35".
Last year's weekend attendance was recorded as 303,627.

“Brazil is an important part of Formula 1’s history and our future, and I am delighted that this five-year extension will see us continue racing in Sao Paulo until 2035," president and CEO of Formula 1 Stefano Domenicali said.
"The passion of our Brazilian fans is extraordinary, and every time we return to Interlagos we feel their energy in the grandstands and in the city of Sao Paulo."
The CEO of the grand prix, Alan Adler, called the extension a "source of immense pride", and said it "represents recognition of work built on dedication, investment and a long-term vision".
keyPointsZh: 巴西大奖赛合同原定于2030年到期。
F1宣布将比赛至少持续到2035年。
圣保罗赛道自1973年首次举办F1赛事以来，一直是巴西大奖赛的举办地。
keyPointsEn: The previous contract was set to expire in 2030.
The extension will keep the race on the calendar until at least 2035.
Interlagos has been the exclusive host of the Brazil F1 race since 1990.

items.originalTitle: F1 retains Brazilian GP until 2035 with fresh Sao Paulo deal
detailZh: F1与圣保罗达成新协议，巴西大奖赛保留至2035年
一级方程式高层、圣保罗市和Interlagos推广者已达成一项新协议，将巴西保留在赛历上直至2035年
在利益相关者同意五年合同延期后，巴西大奖赛将至少保留在一级方程式赛历上至2035年
正式更名为圣保罗大奖赛，以反映市政府的财务贡献，巴西赛事上次签订合同延期是在2023年赛事前夕，这是一项将赛事延长至2030年的五年协议。
但是，在F1管理层希望长期锁定其关键市场的愿望中，巴西作为下一个要得到这种待遇的比赛，誓言继续升级其老化的基础设施。长期安排为当局提供了抵消这些投资稳定性的能力。
锦标赛于1990年重返José Carlos Pace赛道，从里约热内卢迁至此地。
detailEn: F1 retains Brazilian GP until 2035 with fresh Sao Paulo deal
Formula 1 chiefs, the city of Sao Paulo and Interlagos promoters have agreed to a new deal keeping Brazil on the calendar until 2035
The Brazilian Grand Prix will remain on the Formula 1 calendar until at least 2035 after stakeholders agreed a five-year contract extension.

Officially dubbed the Sao Paulo Grand Prix to reflect the financial contribution of the city council, the Brazil race last signed a contract extension on the eve of the 2023 event, a five-year deal that took the race to 2030.

But amid a desire for F1 management to lock up its races in key market for the long term, Brazil is the next race in line to get that treatment as it vows to continue upgrading its ageing infrastructure. The long-term arrangement gives the authorities the stability to write off those investments.
The championship returned to the Autodromo Jose Carlos Pace in 1990, switching from Rio de Janeiro.
keyPointsZh: 巴西大奖赛合同延期至2035年
合同延期由市政府财政贡献推动
